title: App crashes when adding treatment - not synced to NS
body:
I have a master phone set up to sync data to Nightscout (REST). Upload treatments is enabled in settings. 

Treatments added on follower phone shows up in the graph in the master phone/xdrip, but not in Nightscout as they are added. Values from sensor are successfully synced to Nightscout, but not treatments. 

BUT if I use `Back-fill data`, all the old treatments get synced. So it seems something is wrong with syncing new treatments. 

When I try to add treatments manually on the master phone the xdrip app crashes and restarts. No sign of anything in the xdrip logs I am afraid. And treatment is not added.

Samsung Galaxy S4, Android 4.3, Xdrip ver d1d4887-2018.09.08 (downloaded latest stable apk yesterday)

comments.body: The crash issue disappeared with nightly version. Closing this.
